summary: Measure bounded convex polygon paint without erasing ancestor clipping, real occluders, or antialias uncertainty.
invariants: Only childless text-free unique-QID XHTML DIVs with strictly convex four-vertex border-box polygons and axis-aligned mapping are supported.
Exclude only own-polygon exterior points beyond a one-CSS-pixel band; never exclude points using ancestor clipping.
Keep hit-stack occluder checks, boundary uncertainty, and the existing five-percent unknown threshold unchanged.
Use fresh source/render evidence and jointly revised DOM, measurement-cache, and sensor versions.
forbidden: Never relabel unknown or covered samples as success without paint-domain proof.
Do not infer path, URL, fill-rule, concave, transformed, text-bearing, or descendant-paint domains.
